# Security Headers

Host: **Netlify** (static). The authoritative artifact is the committed,
reviewable `public/_headers` file — Netlify serves these headers on every
response from the deploy. The `Content-Security-Policy` hash inside it is
**regenerated automatically on every build** by `scripts/compute-csp-hash.mjs`
(§3.4) from the inline theme script in `app/theme-script.ts`; the file below is
the actual committed output, not a prose recommendation.

## `public/_headers` (verbatim, as committed)

```
# GENERATED by scripts/compute-csp-hash.mjs — do not edit the hash by hand.
# Regenerated on every build from the inline theme script in app/theme-script.ts (§3.4).
/*
  Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-HcvLGA0SfVYNoB0UR7c+WQ+TxZLGSHn+WpmFcpheOqg='; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), interest-cohort=()
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
```

## Header-by-header rationale

| Header | Value & why |
|---|---|
| `Content-Security-Policy` | `default-src 'self'` — everything same-origin by default. `script-src 'self' '<sha256-…>'` — **no `unsafe-inline`**: the single inline script (pre-paint theme resolution, §3.3) is authorised by its auto-computed SHA-256 hash; the hash is recomputed on every build so it can never go stale silently. `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'` — required by the design system: the Astryx/StyleX engine and the compiled theme inject `style` attributes/elements at runtime; this is a deliberate, documented tradeoff (style injection cannot execute scripts). `img-src 'self' data:` — `data:` needed only for inline favicon/SVG usage. `font-src 'self'` — fonts are self-hosted (§3.8), no CDN. `connect-src 'self'` — no third-party APIs. `form-action 'self'` — the contact form posts **same-origin only** (Netlify Forms, §2.3); no third-party form endpoints. `base-uri 'self'`, `object-src 'none'`, `frame-ancestors 'none'` — hardening defaults. `upgrade-insecure-requests` — mixed-content guard. |
| `Strict-Transport-Security` | 2-year max-age, `includeSubDomains`, `preload` — Netlify serves over TLS. |
| `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` | Prevents MIME-type sniffing. |
| `Referrer-Policy` | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` — privacy-preserving default. |
| `Permissions-Policy` | Camera, microphone, geolocation, interest-cohort (FLoC) all disabled — the site uses none of them. |
| `X-Frame-Options: DENY` | Legacy clickjacking defence alongside `frame-ancestors 'none'`. |

## CSP ↔ inline script reconciliation (§3.4)

Static export cannot generate per-request nonces, so:

1. `app/theme-script.ts` exports the inline theme script as a single string.
2. `scripts/compute-csp-hash.mjs` (wired as the `prebuild` step) computes its
   SHA-256 and writes `public/_headers` with `'sha256-…'` in `script-src`.
3. The build cannot proceed with a stale or missing hash — it is recomputed on
   **every** build; manual hash entry is a BLOCKING failure per §3.4.

`'unsafe-inline'` in `script-src` would be a BLOCKING failure; it is not present.

## Verification

- Lighthouse **Best Practices = 100** on all 9 exported routes (27 runs,
  medians in `qa/lighthouse/`, aggregated by `scripts/median-lighthouse.mjs`).
- The emitted pages were checked to contain no third-party script, tag, or
  fetch (§2.3) — the CSP above would block any that appeared.
